ruling_text:
Cvri2600083 Doe v. Does 1-50

MOTION TO QUASH OR, IN THE
ALTERNATIVE, MODIFY DEPOSITION
SUBPOENA FOR PRODUCTION OF
BUSINESS RECORDS; REQUEST FOR
IMMEDIATE STAY OF PRODUCTION
PENDING HEARING
Tentative Ruling: The hearing is continued and the parties are ordered to properly meet
and confer and thereafter submit a joint declaration no later than 10 calendar days prior
to next calendar date.
